question: Who was appointed as the CEO (Chief Executive Officer) of NITI Aayog in February 2023?
solution:
The correct answer is __**BVR Subrahmanyam**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• BVR Subrahmanyam was appointed as the CEO of **NITI Aayog** in February 2023, succeeding Parameswaran Iyer.
 
• He is a 1987-batch IAS officer of the Chhattisgarh cadre and has held several key positions in the government.
 
• BVR Subrahmanyam previously served as the Commerce Secretary of India before taking up the position of NITI Aayog CEO.
 
• He is well-known for his role as the Chief Secretary of Jammu & Kashmir during the region's transition into a Union Territory in 2019.
 
• His appointment is expected to bring strategic leadership to NITI Aayog's initiatives, focusing on policy formulation and implementation for India's development.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **NITI Aayog (National Institution for Transforming India)**

 
 
• Established in 2015, NITI Aayog replaced the Planning Commission to serve as the premier policy think tank of the Government of India.
 
• It focuses on fostering cooperative federalism through structured support and guidance to states.
 
• NITI Aayog is responsible for strategic planning, innovation, and monitoring the implementation of sustainable development goals (SDGs).
 
• The organization plays a pivotal role in formulating policies for economic growth, social inclusion, and environmental sustainability.
 
 
 
• **Role of a CEO in NITI Aayog**
 
 
• The CEO ensures effective coordination among various departments and stakeholders in policy creation and implementation.
 
• Provides leadership in driving transformative projects and initiatives that align with India's development priorities.
 
• Serves as the link between the government, private sector, and civil society for collaborative efforts.
 
• Focuses on innovation and technology-driven solutions for achieving national and global objectives.
 
 
 
• **Key Initiatives by NITI Aayog**
 
 
• **Atal Innovation Mission (AIM):** Promotes entrepreneurship and innovation across India.
 
• **Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs):** Monitors and supports India's progress on global SDG targets.
 
• **National Energy Policy:** Frames strategies for energy security and sustainability.
 
• **Digital India:** Promotes technology-driven governance and digital infrastructure development.
 
 
 
• **BVR Subrahmanyam's Previous Contributions**
 
 
• Played a significant role in administrative reforms in Jammu & Kashmir during its transition to Union Territory status.
 
• As Commerce Secretary, he contributed to enhancing India's trade policy and export strategies.
 
• Known for his administrative acumen and ability to handle complex governance challenges.
